name: ASPEED Technology Inc.
blurb: ASPEED Technology Inc. is a fabless integrated circuit design company based in Taiwan, specializing in multimedia ICs, computer peripheral ICs, and advanced image processing ICs. The company is a leading provider of baseboard management controllers (BMCs) and KVM over IP solutions for server management, serving major data center and cloud computing clients. With a market capitalization of over NT$700 billion, ASPEED holds a dominant position in the global BMC market, benefiting from the growth of AI and cloud infrastructure.
recent: Over the past month, ASPEED's stock has traded near its 52-week high, reflecting strong demand for its server management chips amid the AI boom. The company reported robust earnings with revenue up 40.6% year-over-year and net income rising 52.8%, driven by increased adoption of its AST series SoCs. Analysts remain bullish on the stock due to its leadership in the BMC market and expansion into new applications.
